verdictBasis: 0 blockers, 2 SHOULD-FIX, 3 advisories. The dispatch gate was 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
verdictStatement: This is the strongest version of the ledger so far and the first in which the contract has been demonstrably stable across rounds my lane did not see: the v6-to-v9 diff touches exactly one substantive path, the guidance array losing the duplicate I first reported at v4. Both claimed v7 repairs hold, all eight recorded digests match my own measurement, the roster claim is falsifiable again and passes, and the advisory-erasure pattern I have reported since v5 is fixed in every record that exists. Two things still fail. The Claude v6 verdict — on disk at the canonical path, REJECT with two SHOULD-FIX and two advisories — has no record anywhere in appliesFindingsOf, while the Codex v6 verdict beside it is recorded; the two findings that verdict raised were folded and credited entirely to the other lane, and the string CLAUDE-V6 does not occur in the document. I note in mitigation that the file is mode 0644 where every other review is sealed 0444, which the coordinator can check and I cannot. Second, honestyRepairsFromV3 still says the duplicate line was 'removed at v4' when the arrays put it at v8, and v9's own v7Note and honestyRepairsFromV7 both say otherwise — one document, three entries, two answers. Neither finding touches the contract, D-096 (A) is minted nowhere, and each fix is a single record and a single clause.

coordinatorNote: REJECT of the artifact, not a disposition of the row. DR-101 stays OPEN at file 08 line 283, and nothing here mints D-096 (A) or any owner grant. The design contract has now been unchanged for four versions and I re-verified it end to end against live bytes rather than inheriting my earlier result — it is not what is failing and has not been since v3. Both findings are ledger entries: add a claude2v6 record, and correct one clause that says v4 where the bytes say v8. Two things the coordinator is better placed to resolve than I am. First, my v6 review file is the only one in the lineage at mode 0644 rather than sealed 0444; if it was never registered, that likely explains S-1 and the fix is dispatch-side, but then the ledger should say so rather than be silent. Second, the Claude lane produced no v7 or v8 verdict while Codex reviewed both, so the two lanes are now out of step by two rounds — v9 folds Codex v7 findings and has never seen a Claude verdict on v7 or v8. I renew the recommendation I made at v6, which the intervening rounds bear out: rather than another per-finding successor, specify the ledger's shape once — a fixed record schema per lane-round with mandatory advisories, a rule that no fold may be asserted for a path the roster does not name, and version-absolute rather than relative references like 'this successor'. All five findings I have raised since v4, and both of today's, would have been prevented by that one constraint.
